rationale: Executive Order 13230 (October 12, 2001; 66 FR 52841) established the President's Advisory Commission on Educational Excellence for Hispanic Americans and the White House Initiative in the Department of Education. Section 4(a) of Executive Order 13555 (signed October 19, 2010; 75 FR 65417, held official Federal Register text) reads "(a) This order supersedes Executive Order 13230 of October 12, 2001." It names the whole order without limitation and has no delayed effect, so every clause of Executive Order 13230 had ended by October 19, 2010 at the latest; the Commission may have ended earlier under Section 8 (30 days after its final report unless extended), which is a lifecycle first-end question, not a status question. Executive Order 13555 created its own Commission and Initiative (later re-established by Executive Order 13634 as shown in held continuance orders); that does not revive Executive Order 13230, and no held text does. The order was not in force on 2026-10-14.
